findings.issue: The purge/hold/policy key uses scope and expectedSpecificRevision without a closed derivation. RecoveryRequest has kind, and purge intent has both policyRevision and holdRevision. Different implementations can derive different keys for the same original action, undermining fixed duplicate/conflict dispatch.
findings.required: Define exact per-kind kind→scope and final key member derivations/types, including purge elapsed versus override, hold add/remove and policy update; signer/registry/replay/native use one fixed function. Retain existing full intent and revision checks. Add finite legal/conflicting/duplicate derivation cases.

findings.section: Original clock certificate and conservative dependency census
findings.issue: Lifecycle.publication.clockAnchorDigest, checkpoint.anchorDigest and certificate.anchorDigest refer to an actual original anchor, but no complete closed anchor record/preimage is defined. A checkpoint is specified, not the anchor it links. This leaves the central later-than-both-confirmations retention proof wire and its identity/custody relationship undefined.
findings.required: Freeze the complete cycle-free private clock anchor record, actual native/publication confirmation references and source observation/kernel identity/tick/error units, exact anchorDigest preimage and original registry placement/birth. Define checkpoint/certificate association and same-anchor replay/reboot behavior. No caller timestamps, predicted COMMIT, or bare hash authority. Add finite controls as obligations only.

findings.issue: The data configuration contextDigest is specified as prior physical bootstrap0.3 ONLY, while the coordinated new application bootstrap/fresh ROOT path needs owner context0.4. Installed inventory.2 authority is only named as a separately enrolled configured logical policy, with no exact configuration/context/trust/request profile dispatch. The proposal correctly says these are gates, but they are not an implementable admitted authority matrix yet.
findings.required: Before full governing adoption, reconcile original physical .3/.4 variants and exact new ROOT/logical/data/clock allowed configuration profile dispatch without widening old tuples/signatures. Explicitly identify which existing-origin and fresh/installed routes are admitted versus still unavailable, retaining the full backlog. Coordinate with independent app/.4 design rather than inventing a generic trust registrar.
